entries.title: Season 86 "K.H.A.O.S" begins August 3, 2026
entries.summary: The next season starts Monday, August 3, 2026, bringing new cosmetics for Hero Valkyrie, Hero Berserker, and an Elite Barbarians Evolution skin.

entries.title: No new Evolution or Hero in Season 86
entries.summary: For the first time in years, the upcoming season does not include a new Evolution or Hero card.

entries.title: Season 86 work-in-progress balance changes
entries.summary: 22 cards are being considered for buffs/nerfs via community polls, including Hero Goblins and Mega Knight Evolution.

entries.title: Ronin: the first brand-new card of 2026
entries.summary: A 5-Elixir Legendary troop released in Season 85 (July 2026) -- the first entirely new card since Vines, roughly a year earlier. Signature mechanic is Parry Damage: blocks one incoming ground melee attack every 3.5 seconds and reflects the blocked damage back at the attacker.

entries.title: No confirmed new card after Ronin yet
entries.summary: As of this research date, there are no leaks or official announcements pointing to a specific new card beyond Ronin later in 2026 -- worth flagging honestly rather than speculating.

entries.title: Season 85 balance recap: 11 cards changed, Hero Tombstone reworked
entries.summary: 6 nerfs (including Hero Magic Archer, the biggest hit) and 4 buffs (including Electro Giant), plus Hero Tombstone reworked into a cheaper standalone threat.
